title: We Are All Junior Talent Now
summary: KC, Chief People Officer at OpenAI & former CIO at Palantir, argues that efficiency is the wrong frame for AI. The prize is a reimagined firm where every role gains an agent manager & EQ becomes what separates people.

title: When Does the US Become a Net Importer of Tokens?
summary: US AI demand grows from 66gw in 2027 while tokens per watt compound 2.9x a year, so the grid only binds if token demand outruns efficiency. Break-even real token growth is ~2.5x a year with no cancellations.
